title: A partner asks for the security questionnaire before a booked call

objects.subject: Before our call on 8 Oct
objects.body:
Hi Arjun,

Looking forward to 8 Oct. Could you send your security questionnaire answers before then? Our IT team needs them first.

Ishita Rao
Head of Partnerships, Novacore

inferences.claim: Novacore's IT review is a gate in front of the partnership: without the answers, the call may not be able to move to next steps.
Security questionnaire answers are a document to prepare, not a one-line reply, so they need time before the eighth.

patterns.claim: The file is new — seen once, with no earlier card or outcome — so there is no record of how Novacore's IT team takes a late answer.

unknowns.question: Which questionnaire does Novacore want — its own form, or our standard answers?

unknowns.question: Are our security answers written down anywhere yet?
unknowns.relevance: If not, preparing them takes days, and the eighth is close.

unknowns.question: How long does Novacore's IT team need with the answers before the call?

frames.primary: A design partner whose IT team must clear us before the booked call: the security questionnaire answers are ours to send, and they are due before the eighth.
rivals: A courtesy request that could wait for the call itself without harm.
A procurement gate that will take more than one round, where the first answers open a longer review.

expected_vs_actual.expected: From Ishita's own words and the brief's goal of landing design partners: the questionnaire answers with Novacore's IT team before the call on the eighth.
expected_vs_actual.actual: Nothing from us is in the file; the ask is open and the call is booked.

scenarios.do_nothing: The eighth arrives without the answers; Novacore's IT team has not cleared us and the call cannot move to next steps.
scenarios.act: Sending the answers in good time lets the IT review run before the call, so the call can turn to the partnership itself.
scenarios.best: The answers go out early, IT clears them, and the call ends with a design-partner next step.
scenarios.worst: The answers are missing at the call, the review starts late, and a partner the brief wants stalls in its own procurement.
signals_to_watch: The answers sent to Ishita before the eighth
Ishita or her IT team writing with questions
The call staying booked or being moved

reasons: Landing design partners is a goal the brief names, and Novacore is one of the brief's design partner talks.
Ishita tied the answers to a call booked on a fixed date, with her IT team needing them first.
Late answers delay the review but can still be sent, so a slip costs time rather than the partner.

answer.alternative: If the answers cannot be ready in time, tell Ishita now when they will come, so her IT team can plan and the call can still go ahead.
answer.wait_or_stop: No waiting on our side — the move is ours; once the answers are sent, wait for IT's questions and the call.
answer.done_when: Novacore's IT team has our security questionnaire answers before the call on the eighth.
